events.body:
## Outcome

Make personal and organization identities auditable across device loss, key rotation, maintainer delegation, and recovery.

## Implementation

- Support passkey and hardware-authenticator enrollment, multiple devices, named device revocation, and recovery-code fallback.
- Define signed rotation records that bind old and new keys, reject rollback, and retain historical signature verification.
- Add N-of-M social recovery with time delay, cancellation, and an auditable recovery event.
- Represent organization actors as threshold-managed keysets with scoped delegated maintainers.
- Add timestamped external-account proofs and trust scopes for maintenance, review, mirroring, release signing, and security contact roles.

## Acceptance criteria

- Lost-device recovery never lets one recovery participant take control alone.
- Revoked keys cannot author new accepted events but continue to verify historical events.
- Organization threshold and delegation changes are signed, versioned, and replay-safe.
- Trust in one scope never grants another scope.
- Rotation, recovery, and proof fixtures converge in desktop, browser, and relay validation.

## Dependencies

Builds on browser handoff in #446 and the native signed-event rules in #440.

## Verification

Run device-add/remove, hardware-authenticator, N-of-M recovery, canceled recovery, rotation, rollback, organization threshold, delegation expiry, and scoped-proof vectors.
